newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis gives Lithuanian shares a lift.
newsitem.headline: Hermis gives Lithuanian shares a lift.

text.p: Healthy trade in Hermis Bank gave the Lithuanian stock exchange a lift on Wednesday, accounting for 464,000 litas of total central market turnover of 810,000 litas.
The official index edged up 5.95 points to 903.24 points, but group A shares were off 16.31 points at 1926.13.
"On the overall market, prices were down," said Aurimas Mazdzierius, a broker with Suprema.
Central market turnover rebounded to 810,000 litas from 429,000 litas.
"It's because Hermis had almost half a million litas turnover," Mazdzierius said.
Brokers had been waiting for Hermis to start performing since the bank reported positive results for the first four months of 1997.
"If the market had been more active, the price for Hermis would have gone up faster," said Grazhina Bachiuliene, a broker with Vilfima.
Rival Vilnius Bank inched up to 230 litas from 225 litas, but its central market turnover was an uneventful 50,000 litas.
The relatively unknown Marijamoples Canned Milk jumped to 0.92 litas from 0.84 litas.
"Compared to Birzhiu Dairy and Rokishkis Cheese, Marijampoles is not well-known, but I think it will become popular among investors," Bachiuliene said.
The company was moved into the bourse's A group in April. It reported 2.03 million litas profit in the first quarter of this year. The state owns 66.5 percent of Marijampoles.
